subject.title: fix(openai): Codex OAuth token refresh bypasses proxy in restricted regions

question: Should OpenClaw route OpenAI OAuth token exchange and refresh POSTs through configured environment proxy variables for the OpenAI plugin?
rationale: The code change is small and matches the intended proxy bug, but OAuth credential POST routing is an auth-provider trust-boundary choice that green CI does not settle.

options.title: Accept env-proxy OAuth routing with helper and proof
options.body: Require the named trusted env-proxy helper, focused exchange/refresh assertions, and redacted refresh proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the smallest raw-flag patch
options.body: Maintainers can accept the current raw deprecated fields and current screenshots, but that leaves contract drift and weaker refresh proof.

options.title: Keep OAuth token POSTs strict
options.body: Reject this PR direction if OAuth credential requests should not honor operator env proxy settings in OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Accept env-proxy OAuth routing with helper and proof
recommendation.body: Require the named trusted env-proxy helper, focused exchange/refresh assertions, and redacted refresh proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle appears in recent OpenAI provider and plugin SDK fetch-seam history, which is the closest owner boundary for the trust decision.
